---
title: "Practical 1.1"
author: "Alfie Swinton"
---

I will calculate the total number of genes with regionally elevated expression in the cerebral cortex, basal ganglia, thalamus and hypothalamus regions in human, pig and mouse.

```{r}
human_genes <- sum(180, 83, 57, 110)
print(paste("the number of genes with regionally elevated expression in the human forebrain is", human_genes))
pig_genes <- sum(109, 157, 31, 45)
print(paste("the number of genes with regionally elevated expression in the pig forebrain is", pig_genes))
mouse_genes <- sum(55, 185, 60, 98)
print(paste("the number of genes with regionally elevated expression in the mouse forebrain is", mouse_genes))
```

We can see that the species with the highest number of genes with regionally elevated expression in the forebrain is the human.
